capture_method: installed npm CLI (Windows install reached from WSL) against loopback capture server, isolated PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and --session-dir, fake key, synthetic prompt
provider: custom models.json providers: capture-responses (openai-responses) and capture-completions (openai-completions)
notes: Only field presence and salted digest relations are recorded; raw session IDs, prompts, and Authorization are never stored.
openai-completions sent no session header and no prompt_cache_key by default.
openai-responses sent session_id and x-client-request-id equal to the session, plus prompt_cache_key.
The bundled extension hook before_provider_headers injected X-NewAPI-Session-ID successfully (fixture scripts/capture-fixtures/pi-session-affinity.ts).
A one-off summarization/compaction request can carry only the injected X-NewAPI-Session-ID with no session_id and no prompt_cache_key.

records.gap: The summarization call disables prompt caching and omits session_id, so only the injected X-NewAPI-Session-ID keeps it on the session.

relations.compact: same session_id_key for the main request; summarization request keeps affinity only via the injected header
relations.completions: no default session field; must rely on an injected header
